description: This file defines a jQuery UI widget called 'nestedSortable' that extends the sortable functionality to support nested, tree-like sortable lists with expand/collapse features. It includes methods for serialization, hierarchy conversion, and level management, and handles drag-and-drop interactions for nested structures.

classes.name: mjs.nestedSortable
classes.description: A jQuery UI widget extending sortable to support nested, tree-like structures with expand/collapse functionality.

methods.name: _create
methods.description: Initializes the nestedSortable widget, sets up classes for tree nodes, and prepares the list for nested sorting.

methods.name: _destroy
methods.description: Cleans up data and restores original sortable state.

methods.name: _mouseDrag
methods.description: Handles the dragging logic, including rearrangement, expanding/collapsing nodes, and updating positions.

methods.name: _mouseStop
methods.description: Finalizes the drag operation, reverts if position is invalid, and triggers events.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes the nested list into a query string format.

methods.name: toHierarchy
methods.description: Converts the list into a hierarchical JavaScript object.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the list into an array of items with depth and parent information.

methods.name: _clearEmpty
methods.description: Removes empty nested lists and updates node classes.

methods.name: _getLevel
methods.description: Calculates the nesting level of a list item.

methods.name: _getChildLevels
methods.description: Determines the maximum depth of child nodes.

methods.name: _isAllowed
methods.description: Checks if nesting a node at a certain level is permitted based on maxLevels and custom rules.
